pages.text: Put a $(item)Signal Box$() wherever you like (build the box round it) and click it: its screen is a live map of the railway within 96 blocks, north up: the track, turntables, stations, every train car as it moves, each signal's lamp and the way each switch is set. Hover over anything to see what it is.

$(li)Click a $(l)switch$() on the map to throw it to its next way (not if redstone holds it).$(li)Click a $(l)signal$() to hold it at red, so trains stop at it, and again to let it go. A held signal has a white ring round its lamp.$(br2)Drag the map to move it; scroll to zoom. Breaking the box lets go of every signal it held.
The map: the loop and its trains, the main line and its junction.

$(l)Routes$(): click Routes, then a signal, then the next signal along: the switches between are set and held the way the route goes (in blue) until a train has gone through. Click the first signal again to cancel it.$(br2)Click a $(l)turntable$() on the map to turn it to its next track.
A route set round the loop.
The box remembers the track it's seen: track out of the loaded world is still drawn, greyed. A comparator by the box reads how many trains are on its map.
